items.body: Are you sending a token with your request? The "No authentication challenges found" errors makes me think you could be either passing a token to an endpoint that doesn't require it (e.g. the default sandbox app), or passing an invalid token with the request.
I should have replied got his earlier, however, the issue seemed to be down to a number of issues, the entityid was slightly wrong and the data I was posting wasn't correctly formatted.
